sources.title: Sucker Punch lays off 24 to align with next project's needs
sources.description: Ghost of Yotei dev Sucker Punch has laid off staff, a reduction made both amid ongoing market turbulence and as the studio looks toward its next game.

sources.title: Sucker Punch Productions reportedly lays off 24 employees following launch of Ghost of Yōtei: Complete Edition
sources.description: Internal email suggests developer made decision after "carefully observing the challenges in the market and reviewing the team needs for [its] next project"

sources.title: Entlassungen bei Sucker Punch: Sony baut weiter Stellen ab
sources.description: Der „Ghost of Yotei“-Entwickler Sucker Punch hat laut einem Bericht 24 Stellen gestrichen. Für Sony ist es nicht die erste Entlassungswelle in diesem Jahr.
